digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day ended with clearer direction for the SMS program and several intake-routing updates, though nothing is marked complete in today's dashboard yet. Monday opens with timecards and a dense run from the SMS touchpoint through portfolio reviews.

items.label: Finish routing the Court and Phase 2 intake batch
items.detail: Jean routed several new Court requests to the CM-CoE this afternoon. Confirm ownership, priority, and the escalation path for the remaining Court and Phase 2 items.

items.label: Answer the Amazon Connect quota and user-count questions
items.detail: Lock owners for the user list, concurrent-call estimates, phone numbers, peak volume, and go-live counts so setup can move forward.

items.label: Continue Latent Variables testing and reply to Yash
items.detail: Finish enough testing to decide whether to answer by email or take the offered call, so the Juniper/Latent Variables evaluation does not sit idle.

items.label: Draft the CoE/project-coordinator transcript visual
items.detail: The CoE touchpoint was canceled this afternoon. If the source transcript is available elsewhere, finish the visual and carry any ownership questions into the next CoE discussion.

items.label: Turn the agreed SMS program structure into a charter and sign-off path
items.detail: The proposal is to use one shared legal-compliance workstream with channel-specific execution, starting with SMS. Confirm the IT stakeholders, draft the project charter, and route it for sign-off.

items.label: Review Thiago's Bonus Restructure charter
items.detail: Scan the charter for decisions, missing scope, and whether Thiago needs a reply before next week's project work begins.

items.label: Plan the Levelpath procurement course before the new deadline
items.detail: The Rippling course is due August 8 at 3:37 PM. Block time or delegate the follow-through before next week's project stack takes over.

items.label: Decide the Bio Appointment Reschedule access request
items.detail: Approve or route Elimar Del Valle Toro Vera's Asana access request if it supports the EPMO handoff ahead of the August portfolio path.

items.label: Decide whether to restore the expired BCP/Incident Response recording
items.detail: Restore the April 2 recording only if it still supports current Incident Response evidence or handoff needs.

items.label: Check the ICE Preparedness Plan Miro update
items.detail: Review the new activity if it affects launch readiness, risk language, or a stakeholder decision.

items.label: Jean/Sara 1:1 was canceled
